summary: Select one exact indexed .eml or .msg file for local current-header questions in multi-Email runs.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptability across realistic Email projects containing more than one message
The previous single-Email shortcut correctly rejected an otherwise-unspecified question when more than one Email existed
An exact indexed file name provides a deterministic target without fuzzy retrieval, filesystem access or a model call
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only strict English Subject, sender, recipient and Date forms naming one exact .eml or .msg file use the shortcut.
Names containing spaces require quotes; paths and wildcard tokens are rejected rather than normalized or expanded.
Matching is exact and case-insensitive against indexed project file names; zero and duplicate matches fail closed.
The shortcut does not perform fuzzy matching, filesystem search, mailbox access, delivery-time inference, thread-position inference, identity resolution or authority selection.
